label: Codex Access
description: A Codex login, for the Codex nodes' `access`: your ChatGPT login file (on a local install only) or an OpenAI API key (anywhere). One connection serves however many Codex nodes. weft keeps a ChatGPT login alive itself: it renews the login once when it is due and hands every Codex node the same fresh token, and Codex never renews it on its own.

steps: On a machine where Codex is installed, run `codex login` and sign in with your ChatGPT account.
Open `~/.codex/auth.json` and paste its whole content below.

Log that machine out afterwards (`codex logout`), or run `codex login` there again to give it a login of its own: from now on weft renews this one, and each renewal stops the copy on that machine from renewing.
Open platform.openai.com, API keys, and create a key.
Paste it below and name the connection. Calls are billed to that API account.

outputs.name: access
outputs.description: Wire into the Codex nodes' `access` input.
